title: Secondary Mathematics 1 (with STACK)
description: Secondary Mathematics 1 from the Republic of South Sudan's Ministry of General Education and Instruction, covering: Natural numbers, factors and proportion; measurement; geometry and trigonometry; algebra; and statistics and probability. This is a variant of the original textbook with interactive STACK examples embedded, so learners can practise with automatically marked questions.
authors: The Republic of South Sudan, Ministry of General Education and Instruction
subject: math
